holoocean.interpretation: The final HoloOcean PPO policy was trained in calm conditions with neither current nor wind disturbance.

cross_arm_comparison.interpretation: The final four-policy training curriculum was symmetric and calm. Current-only evaluation therefore measures zero-shot robustness, not robustness learned from a disturbance curriculum.

manifest_note: The HoloOcean run manifest records disturbance_mode=zero. wind_mode is reconstructed from the trainer default and its comparison-mode guard because wind_mode was not serialized into that manifest.
